en.headline: sogeisetsu opens 3 openchamber issues on multi-run UI/docs/test gaps
en.summary: On 2026-10-03, sogeisetsu made 3 commits in their personal repository sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu. They opened three issues in openchamber/openchamber, all related to the multi-run feature after commit d9fbf6b removed the sidebar header button. Issue #4337, opened at 12:52 UTC, reports that multi-run documentation still references the removed sidebar header button, which has moved to the composer. Issue #4345, opened at 15:10 UTC, notes that the command palette's 'Parallel run' entry shares the checkbox-multiple icon with the sidebar's 'Select sessions' toggle. Issue #4346, opened at 15:10 UTC, flags that SidebarHeader.test.tsx still passes even though onOpenMultiRun and canOpenMultiRun were removed in d9fbf6b. The openchamber-bot replied to both #4337 and #4345, marking them as fix-ready with traced causes. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 在 openchamber 提交 3 个关于多运行功能的 issue
zh.summary: 2026年10月3日，sogeisetsu 在个人仓库 sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 中提交了 3 次代码提交。同日，他们在 openchamber/openchamber 中创建了三个 issue，均与 d9fbf6b 提交移除侧边栏头部按钮后的多运行功能相关。#4337（12:52 UTC 创建）指出多运行文档仍引用已移除的侧边栏头部按钮，该功能已移至 composer。#4345（15:10 UTC 创建）反映命令面板的 'Parallel run' 条目与侧边栏 'Select sessions' 切换共用 checkbox-multiple 图标。#4346（15:10 UTC 创建）指出 SidebarHeader.test.tsx 在 d9fbf6b 移除 onOpenMultiRun 和 canOpenMultiRun 后仍然通过。openchamber-bot 分别回复了 #4337 和 #4345，标记为 fix-ready 并追踪了原因。当日无合并请求、代码审查或版本发布记录。
